name: @meir-labs/skill-drain-studio
description: The meirlabs Drain Studio skill — the whole bookmark-to-PR loop: a daily agent pipeline that triages X bookmarks into Linear tickets, then drains top-priority tickets into reviewable draft PRs via a PM-led agent team with a hard human-review gate (it never merges anything itself). The skill is the map; the runnable machinery — conductor, helper CLIs, launchd schedules, Supabase migration, agent role briefs, test harness — lives at github.com/meirlabs/drain-studio. npx installs the skill into .claude/skills.
author: Meir Rosenschein
